name: Farka Mühlenkamp
original_name: ファルカ・ミューレンカンプ
source: A pilot in the Stasi's 101st Battalion Wehrwolf. Farka specializes in halberds, and is the equal of both Anett Hosenfeld and Theodor Eberbach in close quarters combat. Unlike Anett, Farka will not hesitate to kill another human. As a Stasi pilot, the petite girl became used to killing dissidents and defectors.
